shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' app/lib/auth.ts && echo '---' && sed -n '1,200p' app/page.tsx && echo '---' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > app/admin/forbidden.tsx <<'EOF' import Link from 'next/link' export default function Forbidden() { return (

403 · Forbidden

You are signed in, but your account does not have permission to view the admin area.

If you think this is a mistake, please contact an administrator or return to the home page.

Back to Home

) } EOF"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next.config.ts app/admin/page.tsx app/admin/forbidden.tsx tsconfig.json package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'apply_patch "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
 {
   "compilerOptions": {
     "target": "ES2017",
-    "lib": [
-      "dom",
-      "dom.iterable",
-      "esnext"
-    ],
+    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
@@
     "plugins": [
       {
         "name": "next"
       }
     ],
     "paths": {
-      "@/*": [
-        "./*"
-      ]
+      "@/*": ["./*"]
     }
   },
-  "include": [
-    "next-env.d.ts",
-    "**/*.ts",
-    "**/*.tsx",
-    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
-    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"
-  ],
-  "exclude": [
-    "node_modules"
-  ]
+  "include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts"],
+  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
 }
*** End Patch"'
/bin/bash -lc 'if [ -d .next ]; then find .next -type f -delete && find .next -type d -empty -delete; fi'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba next.config.ts && echo '---' && nl -ba app/admin/page.tsx && echo '---' && nl -ba app/admin/forbidden.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- next.config.ts app/admin/page.tsx app/admin/forbidden.tsx package.json && echo '---' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
npm run build >/tmp/next-build.log
npm run start -- --port 3100 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
server_pid=$!
cleanup() {
  kill $server_pid >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in {1..40}; do
  if curl -sS -o /tmp/admin-body.html -D /tmp/admin-headers.txt http://127.0.0.1:3100/admin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.25
done
cat /tmp/admin-headers.txt | sed -n '"'1,20p'
"
